_description: Privacy Policy for the Shot Çarkı mobile application by Sogepps.
intro:
We at Shot Çarkı ("App") value your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information is collected when you use the app, how it is used, and how it is protected.

By using the App, you accept this Privacy Policy.
s1_p1: Shot Çarkı does not require an account, login, or mandatory personal data such as your real name, email address, or phone number.
s1_p2: Data created during gameplay may include:
s1_li1: Player names you enter for the current session
s1_li2: In-game scores, shot counts, and turn progress
s1_li3: Selected player count and game settings
s1_p3: This information is stored only on your device to run the game. It is not uploaded to our servers. Task prompts are pre-written entertainment content; the App does not access your contacts, photos, browser history, or other private device data.
s2_p1: To improve performance and stability, the following anonymous information may be collected automatically:
s2_li2: Device type and operating system version
s2_li3: General diagnostic data from the app platform
s2_p2: This data does not include player names, scores, or task content from your game sessions.
s3_p1: Shot Çarkı may use third-party advertising services (such as Google AdMob) to show banner and interstitial ads. These providers may collect advertising identifiers and anonymous usage data to deliver and measure ads.
s3_p2: Ad providers are governed by their own privacy policies. You can limit personalized ads in your device settings.
s4_p1: Shot Çarkı is a party game that may reference alcohol ("shots") as an optional forfeit. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13. The App is intended for adult social settings; underage players should not consume alcohol. Parents and guardians should supervise younger users.
s5_p1: We design Shot Çarkı to keep gameplay data on your device. We take reasonable measures to protect any data processed by the App.
s5_p2: No method of electronic storage or transmission is 100% secure. Uninstalling the app removes locally stored game data from your device.
s6_p1: The App may rely on third-party services (e.g. Google Mobile Ads) with their own privacy practices. Shot Çarkı is not responsible for how those services handle data. We recommend reviewing their policies.
s7_p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page and take effect when published.
